outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic anatomy diagram and classification table, not a data plot; no statistical comparison is presented.
Panel B is a conceptual/schematic diagram outlining the study aim, not a data plot requiring statistics.
Panel C is a schematic illustration of the experimental method (luciferase recording), not a data plot.
Panel D shows illustrative example traces representing an analysis workflow, not a statistical comparison between groups, so no test is required.
Panel E is an illustrative correlation heatmap depicting the workflow concept, not a reported statistical comparison with significance claims.
Panel F shows a schematic example growth curve illustrating the method, without any statistical significance claim between conditions.
Panel G shows illustrative dose-response curves depicting the workflow concept, with no statistical comparison or significance markers shown.
Panel H is a schematic illustration of a genomic analysis workflow using icons and mock heatmap/mutation grid, not an actual statistical result.
Panel I shows example PCA and 3D clustering plots illustrating the concept of subtype definition; no significance indicators or statistical comparisons are presented.
